$comment: Every user-visible feature and protocol capability of Ghostly. Tests declare what they cover with @feature:<id> (Playwright tag) or // covers: <id> (vitest, Rust). scripts/test-map.mjs checks this file against the tags. Edit by hand; keep one feature per line.

cashu-mint.title: Cashu mint with a fake Lightning backend (cdk-mintd)

pkarr-relay.title: Pkarr relays over HTTP (peer discovery for browsers)

mainline-dht.title: The Mainline DHT (BEP44), reached directly over UDP

turn.title: A TURN server for WebRTC behind NAT

nostr-signer.title: A NIP-07 browser signer (or NIP-46 bunker)

oidc-issuer.title: An OpenID Connect issuer (ID tokens + JWKS)

doh-resolver.title: A DNS-over-HTTPS resolver and the proven domain's web server

forge-api.title: GitHub / GitLab published SSH keys API

bark-signet.title: Second's public Ark server on signet

bark-regtest.title: A Bark (Second) Ark server on regtest

usdt-local.title: A local EVM chain with the TestUSDT contract

lnd-regtest.title: Two LND nodes on regtest with a channel

cln-regtest.title: Two Core Lightning nodes on regtest (Commando)

nwc-regtest.title: Two Alby Hubs on regtest Lightning (NWC)
nwc-regtest.fake: fake NWC wallet service in the test process

webln-regtest.title: Browser wallets in front of regtest LND nodes

bdk-regtest.title: bitcoind + Esplora on regtest for BDK

update-feed.title: The release feed (GitHub releases / update manifest)

image-host.title: A remote https image host (picture links)

camera.title: A camera / microphone (fake media devices in Chromium)
